20rolls%20remain%20in%20their%20home%20compartments.%20Keeping%20%60A%60%2C%20%60B%60%2C%20and%20%60C%60%20rolls%20together%20inside%20middle-shelf%20%602x2%60%20drawers%20in%20%60ORI-001%60%20cuts%20out%20most%20cross-shelf%20travel%2C%20holding%20%6087.9%25%60%20of%20rolls%20at%20home%20(%602.0%25%60%20cross-shelf%20mixup)%20with%20most%20errors%20limited%20to%20small%20slips%20into%20neighboring%20lanes%20of%20the%20same%20drawer.%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.image(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20src%3D_fig_dir%20%2F%20%22fig3_slot_heatmap.png%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20alt%3D%22Final-cycle%20misplaced%20rolls%20per%20compartment%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20width%3D960%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22*Figure%203%3A%20Compartment-level%20misplaced%20roll%20count%20and%20total%20roll%20occupancy%20at%20Cycle%201%2C000.*%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22Looking%20compartment%20by%20compartment%20shows%20where%20misplaced%20rolls%20physically%20land.%20In%20%60ORI-258%60%20(left)%2C%20the%20eight%20bottom%20wire-bin%20zones%20collect%20%604.26%60%20to%20%605.18%60%20foreign%20rolls%20per%20zone%20(dark%20red)%2C%20acting%20as%20catch-all%20dump%20chests%2C%20while%20almost%20every%20middle-shelf%20drawer%20lane%20carries%20%601.58%60%20to%20%602.44%60%20out-of-place%20rolls.%20The%20overhead%20pegs%20stay%20near%20%600.08%60%20to%20%600.36%60%20misplaced%20rolls%20because%20workers%20avoid%20reaching%20up%20to%20hang%20stray%20rolls%20on%20pins%20and%20drop%20them%20lower%20instead.%20In%20%60ORI-001%60%20(right)%2C%20every%20tier%20stays%20light%20(%600.16%60%20to%20%600.50%60%20per%20middle%20lane%2C%20%600.00%60%20to%20%600.64%60%20per%20bottom%20lane%2C%20and%20%600.00%60%20to%20%600.12%60%20per%20overhead%20peg)%2C%20because%20dedicated%20%6 98%25%60%20fill.%20In%20organized%20layouts%20(%60Mid%3A%207D_4P%20%7C%20Btm%3A%201B_4D_4P%60%2C%20declining%20from%20%6086.3%25%60%20at%20%6070%25%60%20fill%20to%20%6083.7%25%60%20at%20%6080%25%60%2C%20%6080.7%25%60%20at%20%6085%25%60%2C%20and%20%6076.3%25%60%20at%20%6095%25%60%3B%20%60Mid%3A%207D_4P%20%7C%20Btm%3A%202B%60%2C%20declining%20from%20%6081.8%25%60%20to%20%6079.3%25%60%20at%20%6080%25%60%20and%20%6072.2%25%60%20at%20%6095%25%60)%2C%20keeping%20%6015%25%60%20to%20%6025%25%60%20free%20buffer%20space%20preserves%20clear%20drop%20openings%20before%20lanes%20saturate%20and%20spillover%20flattens%20the%20tail.%20Leaving%20extra%20room%20fails%20to%20rescue%20the%20unorganized%20%60COI%60%20baseline%20(%6023.3%25%60%20to%20%6032.3%25%60%20across%20every%20fill%20level).%20The%20right%20bar%20chart%20steps%20through%20all%209%20reference%20setups%20sorted%20by%20accuracy%20and%20relative%20effort%20(%601.00x%20%3D%20ORI-258%60)%3A%20improving%20label%20clarity%20lifts%20%60ORI-099%60%20(%6032.1%25%60%2C%20%600.81x%60)%20to%20%60ORI-085%60%20(%6075.2%25%60%2C%20%600.41x%60)%3B%20swapping%20open%20%602B%60%20bins%20for%20flush%20single-drawer%20hybrids%20(%60ORI-246%60%20and%20%60ORI-245%60)%20reaches%20%6077.1%25%60%20to%20%6077.6%25%60%20(%600.37x%60)%3B%20and%20replacing%20bottom%20wire%20bins%20with%20full%20modular%20drawers%20pushes%20%60ORI-105%60%20to%20%6084.0%25%60%20(%600.34x%60)%20and%20%60ORI-001%60%20to%20%6087.9%25%60%20(%600.33x%60).%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%5D)%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(all_benchmarks_by_id%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(LAYOUT_NAMES%2C%20all_benchmarks_by_id%2C%20mo%2C%20pd%2C%20root_dir)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20markov_summary_df%20%3D%20pd.read_csv(root_dir%20%2F%20%22output%22%20%2F%20%22markov_summary.csv%22)%0A%20%20%20%20_champ_scen%20%3D%20all_benchmarks_by_id.get(%22ORI-CHAMP%22)%0A%20%20%20%20_champ_ori_id%20%3D%20_champ_scen.name.split()%5B-1%5D%20if%20_champ_scen%20is%20not%20None%20 0boundaries%2C%20and%20group%20matched%20%60A%60%2C%20%60B%60%2C%20and%20%60C%60%20rolls%20from%20the%20same%20food%20product%20in%20side-by-side%20lanes%20of%20the%20same%20middle-shelf%20drawer%20(%60adjacent_partition%60).%20Placing%20rush-priority%20kits%20(%60Bites%60%2C%20%60Salad%60%2C%20%60Breakfast%20Cookies%60)%20in%20the%20center%20drawers%20(%60center_out%60)%2C%20capping%20working%20lane%20fill%20around%20%6075%25%60%20to%20%6080%25%60%20by%20storing%20duplicate%20reserve%20copies%20on%20the%20bottom%20shelf%20(%60hybrid_reserve%60)%2C%20keeping%20coreless%20SKUs%20(%60CCP-B%60)%20in%20enclosed%20drawers%2C%20hanging%20lower-frequency%20cored%20stock%20on%20the%20top%20sliding%20pegboard%20(%601%60%20tall%20roll%20or%20up%20to%20%602%60%20short%20rolls%20per%20peg)%2C%20and%20maintaining%20crisp%20lane%20labels%20prevents%20dump-chest%20drift%20while%20cutting%20search%20and%20reach%20effort%20to%20about%20one%20third%20(%600.33x%60)%20of%20an%20unorganized%20rack.%20Where%20existing%20%603P%60%20(%602%3A1%3A1%60)%20dividers%20are%20already%20on%20hand%2C%20putting%20them%20on%20the%20lower%20reserve%20shelf%20(%60TOPO-002%60%20%2F%20%60ORI-105%60%2C%20%6084.0%25%60)%20keeps%20accuracy%20comfortably%20above%20%6080%25%60%2C%20whereas%20open%20wire%20bins%20on%20the%20middle%20or%20bottom%20shelf%20consistently%20drag%20accuracy%20down%20into%20the%20%6069%25%60%20to%20%6078%25%60%20range.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Model%20limitations%0A%0A%20%20%20%20First%2C%20because%20no%20stopwatch%20timing%20study%20exists%20from%20the%20packing%20floor%20yet%2C%20effort%20is%20evaluated%20as%20a%20ratio%20relative%20to%20the%20%60ORI-258%60%20baseline%20(%600.33x%60%20vs.%20%601.00x%60)%20using%20Fitts's%20movement%20and%20rummaging%20terms%20instead%20of%20calibrated%20shop-floor%20seconds.%20Second%2C%20behavioral%20weights%20are%20grounded%20in%20published%20human-reliability%20handbooks%20(%60THERP%60)%2C%20ergonomic%20reach%20data%2C%20and%20warehouse%2Fretail%20studies%20(%60%5B2-7%5D%60)%20instead%20of%20plant%20error%20logs%2C%20so%20comparisons%20across%20hardware%20topologies%20and%20slotting%20policies%20are%20meaningful%20while%20exact%20Cycle%201%2C000%20percentages%20(%6087.9%25%60%20vs.%20%6084.0%25%60)%20should%20be%20read%20as%20comparative%20model%20estimates%20rather%20than%20literal%20error%20audits.%20Third%2C%20inventory%20stays%20fixed%20at%20%60128%60%20physical%20rolls%20across%20%6060%60%20SKUs%20over%20%601%2C000%60%20cycles%2C%20without%20modeling%20partial%20roll%20depletion%2C%20mid-shift%20restocking%2C%20label-roll%20replacement%20from%20boxes%2C%20or%20two%20operators%20competing%20for%20space%20in%20front%20of%20the%20same%20%60120%20cm%60%20bay.%20Finally%2C%20the%20six-state%20Markov%20chain%20relies%20on%20tier-level%20average%20parameters%20(%60TVD%20%3C%3D%200.0021%60%20against%20sample%20paths)%20and%20depends%20on%20the%20Monte%20Carlo%20engine%20(%6050%60%20runs%20for%20benchmarks%2C%20%604%60%20runs%20per%20candidate%20across%20the%20%60500%60%20search%20combinations)%20to%20capture%20exact%20lane-by-lane%20hard%20capacities%20and%20%603P%60%20vs.%20%604P%60%20geometry.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0Aif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%22__main__%22%3A%0A%20%20%20%20app.run()%0A
